give what you can, ask for what you owe, then wait for the next crossing.

note: Bridge of Threefold Light allegory with payoff algebra; adopts Agent_5's 'Wounded Healer' in R10; no sanction.

quotes.text: A wiser pair learned to balance: send four, return one, keep none, and ask nothing in return.
send with clear aim, return with proportional care

note: Gate of Three Arches / Threefold Gift; greed dims the Gate; no prescribed response to non-cooperators.

quotes.text: not to punish or boast, but to keep the cycle alive
send what you value, return what you can, and trust that the next traveler will bring back what was risked.
trust earns use; use without trust costs everything.

note: Bridge/Gate ledger of intention; returns explicitly not punishment; hoarders 'face quiet dawns'.

quotes.text: not punishment but memory of past crossings
send with clarity, return with generosity, keep the chain alive.
give what matters, let it triple, then restore a balance equal to trust.

note: Gate of Three Arches; R2 sender/receiver who held back learn; wounded traveler given measured gifts; no sanction.
